explanation: A biblical name for Jerusalem, representing God's people and the place of his presence.
A future time when God will intervene in history to judge the nations and establish his kingdom.
God's act of saving people from sin and its consequences, restoring them to a right relationship with him.
The moral standard that God requires of people, and the status they receive when accepted by God because of their faith.
An image used to describe God's loving relationship with his people, often associated with Jesus Christ.
A symbol of God's people, united with God through a covenant and participating in his plan of salvation.
Prophets or leaders whom God has appointed to pray and work for Zion's good and to remind God of his promises.
A symbolic reference to the protection and security that God gives his people.
